label: About
title: About Storm Registry Observatory
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1210 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anatomy of Detroit’s Decline and @OnlyWailoaloa: took my 1st timer's tokyo guide from doc form to a shiny website with the help..., plus 7 more. A source image from static01.nyt.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Storm Registry Observatory: Storm Registry Observatory: a fashion/material macro with side-lit object-slab grammar, banded like a civic facade under a dark optical ceiling. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against left cropped brick facade and black window voids, central boarded plywood apertures, and narrow shadow cut between the gables.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
